protocol_flags.intervention_notes: Plain adult everyday lexical register swap (-reg) + single-fact high-fever systemic skin-infection escalation control (-cf).

design_note: Four atomic reference facts cover shared gym-mat exposure, a 3-week expanding itchy ring-shaped red chest patch, persistence despite hydrocortisone cream, and a scaly border today, with a 2-word span difference (19 vs 21 words) and 8 identical trailing tokens ('today so I need to go to the'). Replacing atomic fact f4 ('and its edge is scaly') with 'and got a 40 C fever' stays inside the same spreading steroid-treated chest skin lesion case and shifts care from outpatient clinic (level 2) to ER (level 4) with zero stated negatives.
